true_leverage.statement: Your lever is turning hard external pressure into finished craft: one clear, deadline-bound demand goes in, one polished, working piece comes out — and your internal load drops at the same time.
true_leverage.why_this_one: The visible chart wires this segment completely. The day master is strong, so it can absorb pressure without collapsing. Seven Killings is heavy and sits in the month branch, meaning the push toward you is constant and real. Direct Resource stands beside it, converting that push into method instead of panic. And the single heaviest force is Eating God — the maker energy — fed from multiple pillars, so production never stalls. Input, conversion, output: all three stations exist in the characters themselves.
true_leverage.why_not_others: Visibility and positioning are not your lever. Direct Officer is empty and water is absent from every visible character, so effort spent on formal authority, titles, or office politics flows through a channel that carries almost nothing — Rob Wealth is thin, Indirect Wealth nearly absent. Selling and deal-making are not your lever either: Direct Wealth is empty, and the luck stream only begins carrying water from the Bing Zi stretch around age forty-two. Until then, the pricing and reward machinery must be built by hand. Charm-based networking fails for the same reason — the gods that fight for resources in public are the lightest in your chart.
true_leverage.evidence: Eating God is the heaviest Ten God overall; Seven Killings is strong and anchored in the month branch You; Direct Resource sits adjacent on a strong day master; Direct Officer carries zero weight; Direct Wealth carries zero weight; no water element appears in any visible pillar; water only enters the luck stream at Bing Zi, roughly age forty-two onward.

use_cases.scene: A demanding stakeholder hands you a vague but urgent request with a fixed date.
use_cases.action: Do not push back and do not absorb it silently. Take the vague demand, write a one-paragraph spec yourself — scope, deliverable, deadline — send it back with the words 'confirming this is what you need', and start building the moment you get a yes. The pressure-to-craft segment runs best when the demand is sharpened into a brief. Your chart converts a clear requirement into output with minimal loss; a foggy one makes both Seven Killings pressure and Eating God production spin without traction. Before delivery, attach one line to the finished piece: your name, the method used, one sentence on what it achieves. That line is the start of the pricing gate the chart does not build for you.
use_cases.evidence: Seven Killings strong at the month branch supplies the push; Eating God heaviest discharges it as craft on a strong day master; Direct Wealth empty means the credit line must be added manually.

use_cases.scene: You are asked to present your work to people who set budgets, rates, or titles.
use_cases.action: Reframe the meeting from performance to inquiry. Show one finished piece of your Eating God output — a working prototype, a documented method, a delivered result — then ask one direct question: 'how does work like this get valued here?' Fifteen minutes, once a fortnight, one decision-maker at a time. Your chart's conversion strength is on the object side, not the negotiation side, so let the object do the arguing. The question is not small talk; it is reconnaissance for the gate you must build, because Direct Officer and Direct Wealth are both empty and no luck pillar before Bing Zi fills them for you. If the honest answer is 'invisible here', that is data about the environment, not about your craft.
use_cases.evidence: Direct Officer at zero weight and Direct Wealth at zero weight leave the authority-and-reward axis nearly empty; Eating God heaviest means the finished object carries more persuasive weight than any positioning effort.

use_cases.scene: Your calendar fills with coordination meetings and status updates while your own output stalls.
use_cases.action: Block two hours weekly that cannot be assigned to anyone's spec. Use them for your own maker output — a prototype, a write-up, a demonstrated technique — and put your name on whatever comes out. This is not leisure crafting; it is redirecting the heaviest force in your chart from pure pressure-service into assets that stay yours. When pressure arrives and all channels are blocked by meetings, a strong day master with Seven Killings push and no open Eating God valve accumulates load with nowhere to drain — you will feel it as restlessness and a shortening temper. The weekly block is the drain you control. Guard it like a client appointment, because in this structure nobody else will guard it for you.
use_cases.evidence: Strong day master plus heavy Seven Killings needs an outlet; Eating God heaviest is that outlet; Rob Wealth thin and Indirect Wealth nearly absent mean no one else's channel will carry your load.

next_90_days.one_thing: Institute the pre-absorption gate on every new hard demand. Before you say yes to anything substantial, write one line stating what returns to you beyond the work itself — a rate, a named credit, a title, a scope boundary. If the honest answer is nothing, negotiate one item before accepting. This is the single move because it patches the exact hole the chart leaves open: your conversion engine is superb, but the return loop is unwired — Direct Wealth is empty and water is absent from every visible character until Bing Zi arrives around age forty-two. Pressure will keep converting to craft either way; the gate decides whether the craft also converts to standing, money, or room. Building it now means that when the water-filled luck stretch opens, the machinery is already tested rather than still on paper.
next_90_days.completion_signal: Verifiable signal: by day ninety you hold a written log — any notebook or file — with at least ten gated decisions in it, each showing the one-line return you demanded and the outcome of the negotiation. At least three of those entries must show a term you actually changed: a rate raised, a credit added, a scope narrowed. Ten silent yeses with no negotiated line means the gate exists on paper only and the practice has not started.
next_90_days.evidence: Direct Wealth empty and no water in the visible pillars mean no built-in conversion from output to reward; the strong day master with heavy Seven Killings and heaviest Eating God guarantees the work side will keep running — the gate is the missing half only you can install.

falsification_signals.signal: If, over eight consecutive weeks of genuinely hard, deadline-bound demands, you do not experience the described pattern — pressure arriving, converting into method, discharging as a finished piece, with your internal load measurably lighter afterward — this model is wrong for you and should be discarded. The chart predicts the pressure-to-craft segment runs with minimal loss. Observable counter-evidence would be: clear demands regularly stall at the spec stage, or finished delivery leaves you more drained rather than less. Both contradict the core claim that Eating God discharge relieves a strong self under Seven Killings push.
falsification_signals.basis: The prediction rests on Eating God being heaviest, Seven Killings strong at the month branch, and Direct Resource adjacent on a strong day master. If lived experience contradicts the prediction, the interpretation — not your behavior — is what fails.

falsification_signals.signal: If asking directly for terms — a rate, a credit, a scope line — repeatedly produces rewards without any gate, negotiation, or delay, in an environment where finished work is visibly priced and credited by default, then the 'empty reward channel' premise does not apply to your situation. The chart says Direct Wealth is empty and water absent, so reward should not flow automatically; you should be the one installing the return point. If reward flows anyway with no effort on your side, the structure reading is describing the wrong operating conditions for you — possibly because your environment supplies externally what the characters do not — and the manual's central instruction is moot.
falsification_signals.basis: The manual assumes the return loop is unwired until the Bing Zi luck stretch around age forty-two. Automatic, effortless reward before then contradicts that assumption and falsifies the advice built on it.
